name: Political instability
value: Indonesia VP resigned; no G20 collapse
summary: Indonesia's vice-president submitted his resignation on 11 Nov amid an impeachment push; no G20 government collapse
state: Indonesia's Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka formally submitted his resignation to President Prabowo Subianto on 11 Nov, amid court cases over his educational documents (Bernama). The House of Representatives pressed ahead with impeachment proceedings on 12 Nov (Jakarta Post). This is a constitutional succession, not a government collapse, and searches on 16 Nov found no G20 coup, contested election or government collapse.
for_you: No direct impact for most readers. Travellers to Indonesia can check FCDO travel advice for the latest situation.
rubric_hit: Normal: no G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in the past month
